assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary is the repository provisional rough polygon, not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and ratios are intake-grade and must be recalculated after official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: All three key-area polygons are rough placeholders derived from the official announcement's names, order and approximate areas.
assumptions.impact: Detailed-design moves are transferable concepts, not parcel or road-boundary conclusions.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, coverage, setbacks, road redlines and statutory controls are missing.
assumptions.impact: Development intensity remains unknown; no approved control values are asserted.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, uses, heights, ages, condition and ownership are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Submitted building polygons are conceptual adaptive-reuse/test-hub envelopes and do not decide demolition, retention or construction.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, sections, traffic volumes, station interfaces, utilities and fire access are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Mobility lines express desired connections only and require transport and engineering verification.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection boundaries for the Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park and related sites are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Public-space and landmark concepts must be screened conservatively by heritage professionals before siting.

assumptions.statement: Public-space ownership, operating permissions, universal-design audit and maintenance responsibilities are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Capability hubs and landmarks are reference components, not approved projects.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, drainage, flood, energy, fire and municipal capacity data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Edge-compute, robotics and adaptive public-space services require later infrastructure capacity and safety review.
